name: marthi-tec
description: Marthi - plataforma de autoatendimento (API Node + React + PostgreSQL)

scripts.test:security: npm run build:api && node --test scripts/security-regression.test.mjs scripts/sales-persistence.test.mjs scripts/email-rendering.test.mjs scripts/whatsapp-auto-provision.test.mjs scripts/work-orders-security.test.mjs scripts/goals-security.test.mjs scripts/totem-unlock.test.mjs scripts/legacy-schema-repair.test.mjs scripts/brand-logos.test.mjs scripts/people-details.test.mjs scripts/legacy-enums.test.mjs scripts/employee-access.test.mjs scripts/store-brand-profile.test.mjs
scripts.build: tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='apps/api/src/db/migrations',dest='dist/db/migrations';const approved=fs.readdirSync(src).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.sql'));if(!approved.length)throw new Error('Migration source is empty');fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dest,{withFileTypes:true}))if(f.isFile()&&f.name.endsWith('.sql')&&!approved.includes(f.name))fs.unlinkSync(dest+'/'+f.name);fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});" && npm --prefix apps/web run build && node -e "require('fs').accessSync('dist/public/index.html')"
scripts.build:api: tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='apps/api/src/db/migrations',dest='dist/db/migrations';const approved=fs.readdirSync(src).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.sql'));if(!approved.length)throw new Error('Migration source is empty');fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dest,{withFileTypes:true}))if(f.isFile()&&f.name.endsWith('.sql')&&!approved.includes(f.name))fs.unlinkSync(dest+'/'+f.name);fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});"
scripts.test:audit: npm run build:api && node --test scripts/module-persistence.test.mjs scripts/security-regression.test.mjs scripts/sales-persistence.test.mjs scripts/email-rendering.test.mjs scripts/client-payment-activation.test.mjs scripts/client-payment-ui.test.mjs scripts/commercial-orders.test.mjs
